slides.texte_overlay:
Quiet Habits That Make People
Trust You Without Trying

1. Talk to everyone
in the same voice

• The boss and the intern
get the same man.

2. Promise less,
deliver more

• Say Friday. Send it Thursday.

3. Learn a little about
their world

• Their job, their country,
their hobby. Then ask.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. Learn a little about
their world

• Their job, their country.
I look it up on the Sophia app,
then I ask.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Give credit when
they're not in the room

• It always gets back to them.

5. Keep secrets even
after a falling out

• Especially then.

6. Answer the question
you were asked

• No dodging. No spin.
Straight answers build trust.
